regionHint: This sets the money symbol, number style, date order and paper size. We guessed from your browser: please check it.
symbolHint: Shown in front of amounts, for example $ or €. Can be empty.
wordHint: Letters only, for example USD. Used in text messages and links.
taxHint: For example VAT, GST or Sales tax.
countryCodeHint: Digits only, without +. Added to numbers typed without a code.
lakhHint: The Indian way of writing lakhs and crores. Leave off for 100,000.
contentList: Your list is used for the file. Nothing is made up.
sampleHint: Made-up names and numbers, so you can see everything working. Delete them before real use.
blankHint: Empty and ready for your own entries. The preview below shows sample data so you can see how it works.
guideLanguage: Language of the Start Here sheet
guideLanguageHint: Hinglish means Hindi written in English letters.
warnFormulas: The file was made, but some formulas could not be checked here. Please open it and look over the totals.
failed: The file could not be made. Please try again.
blankDownload: The download is blank, so you can type your own entries. Choose With sample data above if you want to see it filled in.
notSaved: Your settings are kept in this browser. Your list is never saved and never leaves your device.
fileNotes: Works offline: no macros, no internet needed.
Opens in Excel, Google Sheets, WPS Office and LibreOffice. Formulas are locked so they are not overwritten by mistake; use Unprotect Sheet if you want to change one.
Rates, taxes and rules are only what you type. Check them against your own rules before you rely on them.
previewScroll: Scroll to see more. Colours for status, bars and weekends are shown here as they will appear in Excel.

gantt.unitHint: Days suit projects shorter than about ten weeks. You can switch inside the file too.
gantt.spareHint: Empty rows kept below your tasks, to add more later.
gantt.listIntro: Optional. Paste or upload your tasks to fill the plan. Dates can be start and end, or a start and a number of days.
gantt.noDates: {n} tasks have no start or end date we could read. They are in the list but have no bar. Check the What we read panel above.
gantt.tooMany: Only the first {n} tasks are used.
gantt.previewSample: This preview uses sample tasks. Your download will be blank unless you choose With sample data.

attendance.offHint: Days off are greyed out in every month. Change them if your week is different.
attendance.holidaysHint: One a line: the date, then the name. For example 2026-12-25 Winter holiday.
attendance.holidaysBad: {n} lines have no date we could read. Start each line with a date such as 2026-12-25.
attendance.alertHint: Attendance under this turns red. Use the limit your own rules set.
attendance.spareHint: Empty rows below the names, for people who join later.
attendance.listIntro: Optional. Paste or upload your people to fill the register. A name column is needed. An ID column is optional.
attendance.tooMany: Only the first {n} people are used.
attendance.previewSample: This preview uses sample people. Your download will be blank unless you choose With sample data.

invoice.starters: What do you make invoices for?
invoice.name: Business name
invoice.taxIdHint: Print it exactly as your own rules require.
invoice.taxesHint: Name up to three taxes and type each rate. Leave empty if you do not charge tax.
invoice.taxNote: We do not know your tax rules. The names and rates are only what you type here, so check them yourself.
invoice.roundOffHint: Rounds to a whole number and shows the difference.
invoice.itemsIntro: Paste or upload what you sell. An item column is needed. Description and price are optional.
invoice.customersIntro: Paste or upload your customers. A name column is needed. Address and phone are optional.
invoice.tooMany: Only the first {n} items and customers are used.
invoice.previewSample: This preview uses sample items. Your download will be blank unless you choose With sample data.

billing.usualHint: Used for customers whose price or usual quantity is not in your list.
billing.defaultRateHint: For everyone without their own price.
billing.defaultQtyHint: For everyone without their own quantity.
billing.prefill: Fill every day with the usual quantity
billing.prefillHint: You then change only the days that were different. Turn off to start with empty days.
billing.spareHint: Empty rows kept for new customers.
billing.messageHint: {name}, {amount}, {month}, {business} and {product} are filled in for each customer.
billing.defaultMessage: Hello {name}, your {product} bill for {month} is {amount}. Please pay at your convenience. Thank you, {business}
billing.listIntro: Optional. Paste or upload your customers. A name column is needed. Phone, price, usual quantity and last month's balance are optional.
billing.noRate: Some customers have no price. Type a price per unit above, or add a price column to your list.
billing.tooMany: Only the first {n} customers are used.
billing.previewSample: This preview uses sample customers. Your download will be blank unless you choose With sample data.
